parole.significato: A golf course, especially one situated on dunes by the sea.
parole.testo: From Scots links (“sandy, rolling ground near seashore”), linkis, from Old English hlincas (“rising grounds, hills”).

parole.significato: A loose, disordered collection of things; a heap; a jumble.
parole.testo: From Scots rickle, from Old English hrēac (“stack”) with the Scots suffix -le (“full (of)”).
